body:
two years ago this weekend, the biggest free show of the eras tour happened *outside* the stadium.

for the munich shows (july 27–28, 2024), tens of thousands of ticketless fans climbed the olympiaberg — a grassy hill built from wwii rubble that looks straight down into the olympiastadion. no ticket, no seat, just the whole three-hour show carried up the hillside on the sound. german press called it a "hörerparty," a listening party. fans called the spot "mount swiftie."

from the stage on the last german night, taylor counted them: about 74,000 inside, "and if the reports are correct, about 50,000 beautiful people outside the stadium." picnic blankets, water handed out against the sun, police who called the whole thing peaceful. a stadium's worth of people who came just to be near it.
